profile.goodFor: the last effect on the Master: a peak ceiling and loudness

settings.name: Threshold
settings.what: the highest level it lets through; with Gain boost on, lower is louder

settings.name: Gain boost
settings.what: adds back the level the threshold takes, so lowering it makes the track louder

settings.name: Lookahead
settings.what: how far ahead it looks for peaks (adds delay)

settings.name: Attack time
settings.what: how fast it reacts (no longer than Lookahead)

settings.name: Operating mode
settings.what: the shape of the gain reduction

settings.name: Oversampling
settings.what: higher catches peaks between samples, at more CPU

settings.name: Automatic level regulation
settings.what: a slow compressor before the limiter that evens out the level

settings.name: Stereo linking
settings.what: limits both sides together; keep at 100%
